hero.title: Your Space, Finished with Precision, Built Around You
hero.subtitle: We deliver turnkey renovation and interior finishing for apartments, homes, and commercial spaces — with clear communication, reliable execution, and a result that feels truly yours.

about.title: More Than Renovation
about.description: Your apartment, house, or business space is more than walls and square meters. It is your lifestyle, your comfort, your peace, and the atmosphere you return to every day. We help transform raw interiors into spaces that reflect who you are and how you want to live.

services.title: Complete Interior Finishing, One Trusted Team
services.description: From planning and cost estimation to finishing works and final details, we provide comprehensive renovation and fit-out services under one roof. Our work combines technical precision, practical coordination, and a strong focus on quality, so every stage moves forward with confidence.

projects.title: Spaces That Speak for Themselves
projects.description: Every completed project tells a story of transformation. From modern apartments to commercial interiors, our portfolio reflects careful workmanship, functional thinking, and a commitment to creating spaces that look right, feel right, and work beautifully in everyday life.

process.title: A Clear Process from First Contact to Final Result
process.description: Good renovation starts with good structure. Our process is designed to make every step understandable and well organized — from consultation and on-site assessment to scheduling, coordination, material support, and execution. Clear stages mean fewer surprises and better results.

contact.title: Let’s Talk About Your Space
contact.description: Whether you are planning a full turnkey fit-out, a renovation, or selected finishing works, we are here to guide you. Reach out to discuss your project, ask questions, and take the first step toward a space designed around your needs.

hero.title: About PRO100 Twój Remont
hero.subtitle: Reliable renovation and interior finishing built on trust, quality, and organized execution.

story.title: Who We Are
story.content: We are a renovation and interior finishing company focused on delivering complete, high-quality spaces for people who want more than construction work — they want clarity, trust, and a result they can truly enjoy. We work on apartments, homes, and commercial interiors, helping clients turn empty or unfinished spaces into places with character, comfort, and purpose.

values.title: Our Values
values.content: We believe in reliability, clear communication, respect for the client’s space, accountable workmanship, and organized execution. Every project is approached with care, professionalism, and attention to the real experience of the people who will live or work in the finished space.

why.title: Why People Choose Us
why.content: Clients choose us because they want a team that combines craftsmanship with trust. We help make the renovation process easier to understand, stay in contact throughout the work, support material decisions, and deliver spaces that feel complete — not just finished.

stats.title: Built on Experience. Proven by Results.

hero.title: Our Services
hero.subtitle: Comprehensive renovation and interior finishing for apartments, homes, and commercial spaces.

intro.title: What We Provide
intro.description: We provide renovation and interior finishing services for apartments, homes, and commercial properties. Our offer is designed for clients who want dependable execution, thoughtful coordination, and a final result that is both visually strong and practically complete.

kitchen.title: Turnkey Interior Finishing
kitchen.description: Complete finishing solutions for new apartments, houses, and commercial spaces — from preparation and technical works to final details.

bathroom.title: Renovation and Reconstruction
bathroom.description: Interior renovation tailored to the condition of the space and the client’s goals, whether the project involves modernization, redesign, or full transformation.

basement.title: Painting and Wall Finishing
basement.description: Traditional and spray painting, plastering, smoothing, and surface preparation that create a clean, high-quality base and finish.

fullHome.title: Drywall and Ceiling Systems
fullHome.description: Partition walls, plasterboard structures, suspended ceilings, and custom interior build-outs shaped around the layout and function of the space.

commercial.title: Flooring, Tiling, and Finishing Details
commercial.description: Professional installation of flooring systems, tile works, interior doors, and other finishing elements that complete the space with precision and consistency.

carpentry.title: Electrical, Plumbing, and Material Support
carpentry.description: Core technical installations, renovation supervision, developer unit handover support, and assistance with organizing and purchasing materials.

hero.title: Our Projects
hero.subtitle: A collection of completed spaces shaped by craftsmanship, structure, and care.

intro.title: Spaces That Reflect Our Standard
intro.description: Our projects reflect the range of spaces we help transform — from private apartments and homes to client-facing commercial interiors. Each one is a practical collaboration between vision, workmanship, and execution.

hero.title: Our Process
hero.subtitle: A clear, organized path from first contact to finished space.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: You contact us by phone or message and tell us about your space, your needs, and your goals. This first conversation helps define the direction of the project.

design.title: Assessment & Estimate
design.description: We visit the site, assess the condition and scope of work, and prepare a cost estimate based on the real needs of the project.

proposal.title: Coordination & Agreement
proposal.description: We reserve the timeline, discuss the stages of work, confirm the details, and finalize cooperation through a clear agreement.

construction.title: Start of Works
construction.description: We organize materials, prepare the site, and begin the renovation step by step with structured execution and ongoing coordination.

walkthrough.title: Completion & Handover
walkthrough.description: We review the completed work with you, confirm the final details, and make sure the finished space meets the agreed standard.

quote.title: Request a Quote
quote.description: Tell us about your property, your goals, and the type of work you need. We will review your request, discuss the next steps, and help you move toward a well-planned renovation with clarity from the very beginning.

hero.title: Contact Us
hero.subtitle: Let’s talk about your renovation, finishing work, or interior transformation.

getInTouch.title: Get in Touch
getInTouch.description: If you are planning a renovation, turnkey finishing, or interior transformation, we are ready to talk. Reach out to discuss your project, ask questions, or arrange the first consultation.
